name: Abdus Samad Azad
contribution: Abdus Samad Azad was a veteran Awami League politician who helped lead opposition politics against authoritarian rule and later served as foreign minister.
context: His long political career began in student activism and included work in the Mujibnagar government during 1971. During the Ershad period he became a senior opposition leader and later helped coordinate the movement for a caretaker government.
impact: Azad connects the 1990 democratic transition to earlier anti-colonial, language, Liberation War, and parliamentary struggles. His career also shows how veteran politicians carried organizational memory across successive movements.
